svg.title: Who imports whom among the Python modules of mod-ui
svg.desc: A dependency matrix of 22 modules and 50 imports, ordered from the entry point down to the kernel: every import points down the stack, there are no import cycles, and settings.py and __init__.py are imported by about half of the modules.
svg.metadata:

Right of the diagonal: an import that
goes down the stack (the normal way).
Left of it: an upward import.
